quest.title: Mouth of Eanna
quest.description: A strange chill permeates the air around the river. A mournful voice carried on the breeze whispers:

node.journal_entry: "Children of my chidren, voiceless they cry, lipless devour, haunting my mouth till a blade breaks their power."
The beseeching tone of this archaic voice surely merits some investigation as to it's meaning as well as what it seems to yearn.
